messages:
lena: GigaCloud flagged increased tail latency on their marketplace images after the latest driver 536 push. Long-context models (8k+) show 2-3x token-per-s inference slowdown. Can partnerships + infra triage?

tom: thanks. do we have exact perf numbers & sample traces?

gcloud-eng: sent a short profile in ticket GC-2201. 90th pct latency jumped from 120ms/token -> 360ms/token on our T4-equivalent fleet. stack: Ubuntu 22.04, kernel 5.19, driver 536.12, CUDA 12.2. Repro included.

yasmin: initial hunch: kernel scheduling behavior with the new driver + CUDA 12.2 affects small-batch scheduling. Need to compare with driver 535 baseline.

pm-ally: partner PM asks if we can pause public announcement of the new marketplace image until we confirm stability. They prefer coordinated advisory if rollback needed.

infra-bot: Action logged: PARTNERS-9010. Run A/B canary between drivers 535 vs 536 across identical workloads (1% traffic each).

lena: plan: 1) cut marketplace images pinned to driver=535.120 as "stable"; 2) run A/B canary (1% each) for 4 hours; 3) gather perf traces + nvprof output; 4) decide to roll forward or hotfix.

tom: add the following perf probe snippet to the canary harness:
```
# measure per-token latency
python perf_probe.py --prompt long_prompt.txt --batch 1 --tokens 8000 --repeat 50 --collect nvprof
```

gcloud-eng: can run their SI customers through the harness. we'll share a prebuilt artifact.

yasmin: monitoring rules to create:
- perf_regression_rate = rate(token_latency_99{image=~".*marketplace.*"}[5m]) > 0.15
- cuda_mem_growth = increase(cuda_mem_alloc_failures[10m]) > 0
Make both trigger an incident to PARTNERS-9010.

deploy-bot: A/B canary started: group=gcloud-driver-ab percent_each=1 image_stable=redwood/inference:market-2026-03-driver535 image_canary=redwood/inference:market-2026-03-driver536

lena: also need a soft-fallback route: if token_latency_99 > 300ms for 5m, route affected traffic to quantized model variant and notify partner channel.

tom: who's owning the automated switch? i can wire the routing lambda. will add a safety window: 3 consecutive 1-minute samples above threshold -> trigger.

pm-ally: we'll hold the marketing announcement until canary complete. if we rollback, we want a joint note with recommended action: pin to 535 or use managed image we provide.

gcloud-eng: initial 30m results: driver 536 shows a sustained 2x increase on 99th pct. nvprof indicates kernel launch queuing spikes. attaching traces to GC-2201.

yasmin: ok stop the canary early. we should revert default marketplace tag to driver 535 and open a hotfix branch for driver 536 investigation.

infra-bot: Rollback executed: marketplace image tag set to driver=535.120. Incident PARTNERS-9010 updated.

deploy-bot: Rollback complete. notifies: #partner-gigacloud-channel.

lena: follow-ups:
- hotfix ticket HF-162 created for engineering root-cause on driver 536 (yasmin)
- update marketplace docs + add driver_pin examples (tom)
- draft joint advisory to customers (pm-ally + lena)
- add A/B perf probe to CI for future driver changes (infra-bot)

please add any missing items here. :white_check_mark:
